verdict.rationale: Productboard's own site states this capability almost word for word: one searchable repository for all product requests and feedback from colleagues and customers. The API docs back it up with search and filter over feedback and with routes for bringing in feedback from other tools and conversations. missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on the in-app search experience (as opposed to API search), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can access one searchable repository for all product requests and feedback from colleagues and customers

citations.quote: Access one searchable repository for all product requests and feedback from colleagues and customers.
List and search feedback with structured filters by owner, creator, tags, date range, and status.
Create, read, update, delete, and search customer feedback, complete with text content, tags, owners, source metadata, and customer attribution.
route feedback from proprietary CRMs, internal tools, and other non-native sources into Productboard
Import messages containing ideas & feedback in Productboard.
